extensionBuild.input: sorted dist filenames, NUL, bytes, NUL

manifest.purpose: Two tiny lossless VP9 fixtures with independently checked decoded RGBA bytes and presentation timestamps. Browser colour output and capture remain separate validation boundaries.
manifest.ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
manifest.ffprobeVersion: ffprobe version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

fixture: A real muted 2×2 CSS-pixel HTML video plays a pre-encoded lossless VP9/WebM file only after a supported disclosure. Before capture, all 53 decoded RGBA frames and PTS are checked against the grey35/125 2.08s signal plus grey35 end-frame. No audio, canvas media source, large flashing area or automatic signal playback. rVFC is presentation evidence; expected decoded RGB is not assumed to prove browser colour output.
